import re

# According to RFC9110 Section 5.6.2:
# tchar = "!" / "#" / "$" / "%" / "&" / "'" / "*" / "+" / "-" / "." / 
#         "^" / "_" / "`" / "|" / "~" / DIGIT / ALPHA
# So the special characters should be: !#$%&'*+-.^_`|~
# NOT including :/;@ which are delimiters

RFC9110_5_6_2_TOKEN_SPECIALS_CORRECT = r"!#$%&'*+-.^_`|~"
TOKEN_RE_CORRECT = re.compile(r"[%s0-9a-zA-Z]+" % (re.escape(RFC9110_5_6_2_TOKEN_SPECIALS_CORRECT)))

print("Correct pattern:", TOKEN_RE_CORRECT.pattern)
print()

# Test various strings
tests = ["GET", "GET:", "GET;", "GET,", "GET<", "GET=", "GET>", "GET?"]
for t in tests:
    match = TOKEN_RE_CORRECT.fullmatch(t)
    print(f"'{t}' fullmatch: {match}")

# Also test the delimiter characters from the test
print()
print("Testing delimiter characters:")
RFC9110_5_6_2_TOKEN_DELIM = r'"(),/:;<=>?@[\]{}'
for bad_char in RFC9110_5_6_2_TOKEN_DELIM:
    match = TOKEN_RE_CORRECT.match(bad_char)
    print(f"  '{bad_char}' match: {match}")
EOF
